targets.name: claude-code
targets.note: Claude Code CLI user scope. Edits the top-level `mcpServers` block; everything else in the file is preserved.

targets.name: agents-mirror
targets.note: Plain mirror at ~/.agents/mcp.json. Reference copy; also handy for tools that probe this location.

targets.name: pi
targets.note: Pi agent. Native MCP unsupported; works via the `pi-mcp-adapter` package declared in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json.

targets.name: claude-desktop
targets.note: Claude Desktop (macOS). Enable when you want the desktop app to share MCPs with the CLI.

targets.name: codex
targets.note: Codex (TOML, different shape). Not yet implemented by sync-mcp — placeholder for when needed.
